blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Despite steady revenues, Citicore Energy REIT Corp. (CREIT) grew its net income by 6.6 percent to P1.03 billion in the first nine months, up from P966 million a year earlier. The Saavedra-led renewable energy real estate investment trust said revenues reached P1.37 billion, roughly unchanged from a year ago.
